segments.t: Therefore I exhort the elders among you,
segments.note: 「Therefore I exhort the elders among you」Πρεσβυτέρους οὖν ἐν ὑμῖν παρακαλῶ

segments.t: as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ,
segments.note: 「as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ」ὁ συμπρεσβύτερος καὶ μάρτυς τῶν τοῦ Χριστοῦ παθημάτων

segments.t: and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:
segments.note: 「and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed」ὁ καὶ τῆς μελλούσης ἀποκαλύπτεσθαι δόξης κοινωνός

segments.t: shepherd the flock of God which is among you,
segments.note: 「shepherd the flock of God which is among you」ποιμάνατε τὸ ἐν ὑμῖν ποίμνιον τοῦ θεοῦ

segments.t: exercising the oversight,
segments.note: 「exercising the oversight」ἐπισκοποῦντες

segments.t: not under compulsion, but voluntarily;
segments.note: 「not under compulsion, but voluntarily」μὴ ἀναγκαστῶς ἀλλὰ ἑκουσίως。κατὰ θεόν（13–14番）は WEB 本文に訳出されない

segments.t: not for dishonest gain, but willingly;
segments.note: 「not for dishonest gain, but willingly」μηδὲ αἰσχροκερδῶς ἀλλὰ προθύμως

segments.t: not as lording it over those entrusted to you,
segments.note: 「not as lording it over those entrusted to you」μηδ’ ὡς κατακυριεύοντες τῶν κλήρων。「entrusted to you」は κλήρων の表現

segments.t: but making yourselves examples to the flock.
segments.note: 「but making yourselves examples to the flock」ἀλλὰ τύποι γινόμενοι τοῦ ποιμνίου

segments.t: When the chief Shepherd is revealed,
segments.note: 「When the chief Shepherd is revealed」καὶ φανερωθέντος τοῦ ἀρχιποίμενος

segments.t: you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.
segments.note: 「you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away」κομιεῖσθε τὸν ἀμαράντινον τῆς δόξης στέφανον

segments.t: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder.
segments.note: 「Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder」ὁμοίως νεώτεροι ὑποτάγητε πρεσβυτέροις

segments.t: Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another;
segments.note: 「Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another」πάντες δὲ ἀλλήλοις τὴν ταπεινοφροσύνην ἐγκομβώσασθε。WEB は「and subject yourselves」を補う

segments.t: for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
segments.note: 「for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble”」ὅτι Ὁ θεὸς ὑπερηφάνοις ἀντιτάσσεται ταπεινοῖς δὲ δίδωσιν χάριν

segments.t: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God,
segments.note: 「Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God」Ταπεινώθητε οὖν ὑπὸ τὴν κραταιὰν χεῖρα τοῦ θεοῦ

segments.t: that he may exalt you in due time,
segments.note: 「that he may exalt you in due time」ἵνα ὑμᾶς ὑψώσῃ ἐν καιρῷ

segments.t: casting all your worries on him,
segments.note: 「casting all your worries on him」πᾶσαν τὴν μέριμναν ὑμῶν ἐπιρίψαντες ἐπ’ αὐτόν

segments.t: because he cares for you.
segments.note: 「because he cares for you」ὅτι αὐτῷ μέλει περὶ ὑμῶν

segments.t: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful.
segments.note: 「Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful」νήψατε γρηγορήσατε。「self-controlled」は英語の補い

segments.t: Your adversary, the devil,
segments.note: 「Your adversary, the devil」ὑμῶν ὁ ἀντίδικος διάβολος

segments.t: walks around like a roaring lion,
segments.note: 「walks around like a roaring lion」περιπατεῖ ὡς λέων ὠρυόμενος

segments.t: seeking whom he may devour.
segments.note: 「seeking whom he may devour」ζητῶν τινα καταπιεῖν

segments.t: Withstand him steadfast in your faith,
segments.note: 「Withstand him steadfast in your faith」ᾧ ἀντίστητε στερεοὶ τῇ πίστει。「your」は英語の補い

segments.t: knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.
segments.note: 「knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings」εἰδότες τὰ αὐτὰ τῶν παθημάτων τῇ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ὑμῶν ἀδελφότητι ἐπιτελεῖσθαι。WEB の語順はほぐし

segments.t: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus,
segments.note: 「But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus」ὁ δὲ θεὸς πάσης χάριτος ὁ καλέσας ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν αἰώνιον αὐτοῦ δόξαν ἐν Χριστῷ。「Jesus」は英語の補い

segments.t: after you have suffered a little while,
segments.note: 「after you have suffered a little while」ὀλίγον παθόντας

segments.t: perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
segments.note: 「perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you」αὐτὸς καταρτίσει στηρίξει σθενώσει θεμελιώσει

segments.t: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
segments.note: 「To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen」αὐτῷ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν。WEB の「the glory」はビザンティン本文 ἡ δόξα に対応する。ギリシャ語本文は τὸ κράτος のみ

segments.t: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him,
segments.note: 「Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him」Διὰ Σιλουανοῦ ὑμῖν τοῦ πιστοῦ ἀδελφοῦ ὡς λογίζομαι。「our」は英語の補い

segments.t: I have written to you briefly,
segments.note: 「I have written to you briefly」ἔγραψα δι’ ὀλίγων。WEB は「to you」を補う

segments.t: exhorting and testifying
segments.note: 「exhorting and testifying」παρακαλῶν καὶ ἐπιμαρτυρῶν

segments.t: that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.
segments.note: 「that this is the true grace of God in which you stand」ταύτην εἶναι ἀληθῆ χάριν τοῦ θεοῦ εἰς ἣν στῆτε

segments.t: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you.
segments.note: 「She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you」ἡ ἐν Βαβυλῶνι συνεκλεκτὴ ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς。WEB の語順はほぐし

segments.t: So does Mark, my son.
segments.note: 「So does Mark, my son」καὶ Μᾶρκος ὁ υἱός μου

segments.t: Greet one another with a kiss of love.
segments.note: 「Greet one another with a kiss of love」ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν φιλήματι ἀγάπης

segments.t: Peace be to all of you who are in Christ
segments.note: 「Peace be to all of you who are in Christ」εἰρήνη ὑμῖν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ

segments.t: Jesus. Amen.
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「Jesus. Amen」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない
